prompt: Implement build_extraction_plan(names, destination) in safe_paths.py. It receives archive member names and returns (original_name, destination_path) tuples without touching the filesystem. Treat both slash styles as separators. Reject non-string/empty names, NULs, absolute paths, UNC paths, drive-qualified paths, trailing separators, and any '..' component. Ignore '.' components and repeated separators. Every resulting target must remain lexically under destination. Reject target collisions case-insensitively, including collisions created by normalization. Preserve input order. Raise UnsafePathError for unsafe input. This function plans files only; directory entries are invalid.
